details.refs: Still no in-service photo: searched LALF, TPG, OMAAT and Sam Chui, and none shows the bar. It agrees with ANA's 2019 render: black upper unit, monitor, glass fridge with blue-label bottles, ash doors with round pulls, bright nosing and rail. I cap it at 7.5 because it is unverified against a real photo.

omaat_room_32, kna_31_full, lalf_133/134. The layout matches. Three mismatches: the body is still too dark (#22211d vs #565350); the glass door reads as open shelves; and the brewer is a small black box with a teal LED, where the photo shows a silver espresso unit with a green light in the left cubby.
lalf_133: ash wall with aluminium-framed flaps, red latches at the top and diagonal aluminium rub rails on the lower panels. m04 is too close-up to check the rails.

details.detail: F front wall, flight-deck door, door 1 (q01, m01, m02, m19)
details.refs: omaatF_2/33/40 and ml_DSC_1914 confirm the cloud washi front wall with one loose charcoal drape. The ebony is now grained. The flight-deck door has bolt plates and a kick plate (no in-service photo local).

kna_31_full (right edge) shows a J lav door as a plain warm laminate with a vertical grab, a pictogram and a red no-smoking placard. The render has a heavily grained ash bifold with a white centre strip, and the photo is too warm-lit to settle the finish.

py_37302/py_37303: charcoal monitor frames, handle and strap are clean.

details.detail: Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12, q19)
details.refs: Ovens #6a6b6b-#989795 are now credible. The chiller #555656 is still dark, and the aft-wall labels are uniform.

The F front and rear curtains now match (omaatF_33, y_47300). The PY aft curtain in m10/q13 is one narrow navy column (#2b2f43 in shade): py_37302 shows two wide slate drapes, the left ~0.4 m and the right ~0.6 m fanned, at #46495e/#3c3949.

details.detail: Jump seats and Type A door linings (m13, m17, m18)
details.refs: lalf_133 (crop: door with arc). The housing, grip pocket, arc, OPEN label, window position, bustle and assist bar are right. The arming indicator, arc hue and strap differ from the photo.

issues.detail: Welcome galley body still too dark
issues.problem: The charcoal upper unit renders #22211d-#2a2926 in m16; omaat_room_32 samples #565350 (body by the glass door) and #5a5546. Panel reveals and the stile frames around the glass door are almost invisible.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js raise MONMAT.welcomeChar from #4a4740 to about #6a665d, or give it a small emissive term (e: 0.03) as fridgeLit has, since the recess AO crushes it. Also lighten navyPanel #2d2b29 -> #3d3a35 so the end panels keep their step. Re-sample m16 for a target of ~#4a4740 on screen.

issues.detail: Welcome galley glass door reads as open shelving
issues.problem: There is no glazing surface: between the shelves and boxes the cabinet shows pure black (#0c0b0a). The photo shows a reflective smoked pane (#8c8b85 where it catches the ceiling light) over clearly dimmed contents.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley add a gQuad(0.36, 0.70) at V(gc + 0.02, 1.44, o + 0.09) using a glossy dark material such as { c: '#3a3936', r: 0.06, m: 0.2 } (the engine has no alpha), and drop the box albedos ~30 % so they read as behind glass. Alternatively, lift the interior back '#2e2c29' to '#4a4843' so the cavity is not a black hole.

issues.problem: m10/q13 show a single narrow column (~0.2 m) of curtainY. In py_37302 the PY aft-end curtains are wide pleated drapes: the left one ~0.4 m and the right one ~0.6 m fanned across the opening, with fine vertical pleats. Shaded colour #2b2f43 against photo #46495e/#3c3949.
issues.fix: In buildMon's curtain call (line ~588), pass wide = true for the PY tone as well (so tone 'Y' uses _curtainWide like 'F' and 'R'), and lighten curtainY #585c70 -> #66697c.

issues.detail: Door-lining arming indicator is a black box
issues.problem: The arming window renders as a black face (#26272b) with a large red square flag. In lalf_133 it is a light-grey framed placard window with a green/red diagonal striped lever visible, with no big red block.
issues.evidence: lalf_133.jpeg (crop 500,300-900,900): the indicator at upper fwd shows a grey face with a green+red lever; m17/m18 show a black panel and a red block
issues.fix: In the door-lining loop change the face quad LF(1.54, 0.0125, -0.41, Qf) from { c: '#26272b' } to ~{ c: '#9a9a96', r: 0.3 }, and delete or shrink the 0.05x0.06 MONMAT.red quad at LF(1.46, 0.014, -0.37) to 0.02x0.02.

issues.problem: The photo arc is a crimson/magenta-red (lit #a3696c, shade #82414c) and the assist-bar strap is crimson (#624452), wrapped around the bar. The render arc is pure red (#b3262a) and the strap is an orange square (#cc4e22) hanging below the bar.
issues.fix: Use a local { c: '#a8304a', r: 0.4 } for the arc tube, stop bar and arrowhead instead of MAT.handleRed (07_shell.js belongs to another worker, so keep the material local). Recolour the strap gRBox to '#8e2a3c', and wrap it on the bar by moving it to LF(0.70, 0.33, -0.33) with height 0.06.

issues.problem: The left cubby holds a small black box with a teal LED. The photo shows a silver/chrome espresso-type brewer with a drip tray and a green status light.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley replace the bevBlack brewer box with MONMAT.alu body + steelBright head, and swap the teal LED for MONMAT.green.

issues.detail: Stray blue placard on the F/J J face
issues.problem: Not fixed: placardBlue at y 1.80 floats just above the wall box's blue top band at y 1.58, so two stacked blue items read as a chip.
issues.fix: In buildBulkhead (line ~679) either drop the placardBlue loop or move it to y 1.95 with an 0.06x0.04 quad. omaat_room_36 is not in ref/web/monuments to verify, so confirm before re-adding.

issues.problem: The chiller/stowage insert next to the brewer is #555656, darker than the ovens. The six aft-wall standard units in q19 carry identical labels in identical positions.
issues.fix: In buildGalley raise the chiller material to MONMAT.alu, and vary the label u/v offsets per unit index (the same hash used for the side banks).

issues.problem: The striped fWood layer in q01/m19 reads as uniform horizontal hairlines across 60 % of the frame, more like brushed fabric than wood.
issues.fix: Lower the stripe contrast of the darkWood/cockpitDoor materials (use LAYER.wood with a 03_tex.js LAYER_PARAMS tweak for fWood amplitude, which is a shared one-line edit) or add low-frequency streak variation.
